recommendedFor: Evolved dragon model with Flying_Idle and Fast_Flying clips; simple dragon vehicle control.
limitations: Uses the simple dragon vehicle controller; the numbered flying-creature landing, summon, rope-ladder and flame integration does not apply.

assets.displayName: 飞龙 D01 / Flying dragon D01

integrationMetadata.useWhen: 使用编号 D01 的飞龙模型；支持飞行、落地、召唤（summon）和绳梯骑乘。与进化龙使用不同控制配置；编号是资源标识，官方名称未确认。
integrationMetadata.binding: Load humanoid.FlyingCreatureVisual using visual resources and animationPrefix; pass its root and flyingVisual with this vehicle.spec. The SDK owns its mixer and fixed simulation tick; do not start another animation loop or use generic asset action playback.
capabilities: Flight, boost, glide, brake hover, dodge and flame visual feedback.
Landing, takeoff and the supplied humanoid rope-ladder mount/dismount after ground support and clearance checks.
SDK summon navigation with actual flight/landing outcomes; observe summon and ground phases for completion.

limitations: Ground support is stationary on sufficiently wide, flat, dry surfaces; no ground walking, foot terrain IK, slope perching or airborne dismount.
Collision uses measured body, neck and head core probes; wing tips, tail tips and fur may overlap obstacles.
Flame is visual feedback only; no damage, combat resolution or audio. Original game material graphs and cloth/fur simulation are not reproduced.

integrationMetadata.seatSource: vehicle.spec.seat is authoritative; optional measured Body anchor, no seat.driver GLB node.

assets.displayName: 静态四足动物（诊断用） / Static quadruped (diagnostic)
limitations: Static six-mesh diagnostic animal; no skeleton or authored animation.
The source GLB contains three size specimens. Use exactly the listed glTF node indices to select one animal.
Not a fox or nine-tailed fox reference; do not recommend it for matching those characters.
A character controller can translate this object but cannot supply leg motion.

assets.displayName: UEFN 白色黑关节人形 / UEFN mannequin, white with black joints

provenance.modelModification: User-supplied UEFN BlackJoints LOD1 skin bound offline to preserved Source101 animation rig.

limitations: Racing quad inspired by PUBG; short-wheelbase four-wheel drive with front-wheel steering and original straddle rider.
Single active driver under the current Training contract. Rear passenger socket is reserved; no fuel, damage or multiplayer passenger simulation.
Shared rigid-body wheel physics, raycast suspension, tire forces and automatic powertrain; no deformable tires or damage simulation.
W throttle; S brakes before reversing; Space brakes. Shift adds no boost.
Four-sample hydrostatic buoyancy and stroke-driven drag approximation; no waves, current or capsize simulation.
W repeats single-sided strokes with yaw, S back-paddles, A/D change sides and sweep, Space braces to slow; propulsion requires immersion.

integrationMetadata.useWhen: Use the supplied single-main-rotor helicopter visual with the SDK helicopter flight subtype.
integrationMetadata.binding: Select vehicle.helicopter in project.json, load its verified GLB with world.assets.load('vehicle.helicopter'), attach the returned object to the VehicleInstance object, and use the composed vehicle.spec. The public factory signature remains humanoid.createAircraftSpec('plane'); custom rotorcraft set aircraftSubtype to 'helicopter'. The SDK owns flight physics and the fixed simulation tick.

visual.animationBinding: Collect both aircraft-rotor pivots in traversal order and, in humanoid.onVisualUpdate, assign sample.vehicles[vehicleIndex].aircraft.rotorPhases[phaseIndex] to each pivot's local rotation.y. Do not start a second simulation or animation clock.

capabilities: SDK helicopter lift, hover, forward flight, yaw, roll, landing and wheel braking through aircraftSubtype helicopter.
Verified hash-locked GLB loading through world.assets.load; the model has no embedded animation clips.
Driver seat uses the composed local pelvis anchor [0, 1.3, 0.1].

limitations: 控制与物理由 SDK aircraftSubtype helicopter 提供；本 GLB 不含动画片段，两个 aircraft-rotor 枢轴需要在 onVisualUpdate 中绑定 rotorPhases。
0.1.1 已接通 Registry/Creator 元数据，实际人形登乘、飞行、降落与退出仍需本地运行验收。
Jet propelled personal watercraft with buoyancy, independent handlebars and world-space water spray.
Single original straddle rider; no fuel, damage or ocean wave simulation.
Four-sample hydrostatic buoyancy and stroke-driven drag approximation; no waves, current or capsize simulation.
W paddles, S back-paddles, A/D sweep, Space braces to slow; propulsion requires immersion.

assets.displayName: 单人观景潜艇 / Observation submarine
limitations: Hydrostatic buoyancy and ballast approximation; no fluid solver or pressure damage.
W/S propulsion, A/D yaw, Ctrl dives with ballast, Space surfaces, Q/E roll, Shift slows; hatch opens only at the surface.
Unpowered inflatable boat; paddle propulsion on water, gravity sliding on land and damped contact restitution. Single active driver; passenger anchors reserved.
W repeats single-sided strokes with yaw, S back-paddles, A/D change sides and sweep, Space braces to slow; propulsion requires immersion.
Unpowered parallel skiing on packed snow; no deep-snow deformation, independent leg physics or ski tricks.
W pole pushes only below groundSpeed; turns retain momentum, S / Space brakes, gravity drives downhill.
Unpowered packed-snow approximation; no deep-snow deformation or rollover simulation.
W pushes only below groundSpeed; downhill speed comes from gravity.
Enlarged enclosed single-driver humanoid tank; differential tracked drive and independent turret/elevation.
No firing, ballistics, damage, full suspension or interior walking. F transfers control at a safe boarding point.

assets.displayName: 长途巡航摩托 / Touring motorcycle

limitations: Direct-drive single wheel with original humanoid balance and terrain-checked left-foot support.
Assisted balance, not a free-falling single-wheel rigid-body simulation. No aerial tricks.
